invptol.title: Plus Count Tolerance
invptol.remarks: Percentage by which a physical count can be above the adjusted balance and still be reconciled. An item's tolerance values are storeroom-specific. Maximo uses tolerance settings to determine the accuracy of the physical count. Maximo uses the tolerance value, established in the Organizations application, as the default value, unless you enter a value in the Plus Count Tolerance field on the Inventory tab.

ccf.title: Count Frequency
ccf.remarks: Cycle Count Frequency The number of days between an audit or count of an inventory item.

reservedqty.title: Quantity Currently Reserved
reservedqty.remarks: Total number of items that have been reserved for approved work orders and for internal POs.

icg.title: Count Group
icg.remarks: Count group identifier assigned to an item for selecting items by groups, for a count book in Count Books app.

dfltstagebin.title: Default Stage Bin
dfltstagebin.remarks: The Default Staging bin for this inventory item.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.remarks: The numeric frequency value of the period to create invoices for the consumption of consignment items.

issue2yrago.title: 2 Years Ago
issue2yrago.remarks: Total year-to-date quantity issued from this location two years ago.

receipttolerance.title: Receipt Tolerance %
receipttolerance.remarks: The percentage value of items that can be received over the amount set in the initial agreement.

issueytd.title: Year to Date
issueytd.remarks: Indicates the number of this item that have been issued in the current year.

lastissuedate.title: Last Issue Date
lastissuedate.remarks: Indicates the date and time that this item was last issued.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: Unique identification code indicating the Site level location for an item.

issue1yrago.title: Last Year
issue1yrago.remarks: Total year-to-date quantity issued from this location for the previous year.

modelnum.title: Model
modelnum.remarks: Primary vendor's model number for this item.

binnum.title: Default Bin
binnum.remarks: A unique identification number indicating the primary bin or storage location for the selected item within a storeroom.

itemnum.title: Item
itemnum.remarks: A unique identification number for an item in inventory in the selected storeroom.

bincnt.title: BIN COUNT
bincnt.remarks: An Item is in a single or multiple Bins in a storeroom

expiredqty.title: Expired Quantity in Stock
expiredqty.remarks: The number of a stocked element that has passed the expiration date.

costtype.title: Issue Cost Type
costtype.remarks: The issue cost type of an inventory item can be Average, Standard or Asset. You use the Asset cost type for rotating items only.

orderqty.title: Economic Order Quantity
orderqty.remarks: Optimum reorder quantity of the item in the specified Order Units. Default order quantities are multiples of this amount. This amount should be the optimal point to best balance costs. If needed, this can be changed when the purchase requisition is generated. The EOQ report allows you to get an EOQ algorithm. This report can be used to update the EOQ field.

issue3yrago.title: 3 Years Ago
issue3yrago.remarks: Total year-to-date quantity issued from this location three years ago.

hardresissue.title: Requires hard reservation on use
hardresissue.remarks: Specifies when creating a reservation if the reservation can be only a hard reservation.

storelocsiteid.title: Storeroom Site
storelocsiteid.remarks: Identifies the site where the storeroom is located.

abctype.title: ABC Type
abctype.remarks: ABC analysis in Inventory lets you quickly identify which inventory items represent your company's greatest investment in terms of monetary value and turnover rate. The ABC Type value for a item is determined by running an ABC Analysis report, which multiplies the current YTD issued quantity by the last cost of the item. The items are then sorted in descending order of the dollar value reached by this calculation.

shippedqty.title: Quantity Shipped
shippedqty.remarks: The quantity of items that were shipped, including all reservation types.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: The current status of the item such as ACTIVE, PENDING, PLANNING, PENDOBS and OBSELETE.

avblbalance.title: Quantity Available
avblbalance.remarks: Quantity of items available for issue. This is calculated by the formula: current balance - reserved - expired = available.

reorder.title: Reorder
reorder.remarks: Specify whether to include the item in the inventory reorder process.

sstock.title: Safety Stock
sstock.remarks: Minimum amount of stock to be kept on hand at all times. You can consider the safety stock value to be the amount of stock you want left on hand at the time reordered stock arrives.

invreserveqty.title: Reserved Qty
invreserveqty.remarks: Calculate the reserved qty at inventory

issueunit.title: Issue Unit
issueunit.remarks: Standard quantity by which the item is issued from the storeroom, such as each or roll. Click the Select Value button to view a list of valid issue units.

manufacturer.title: Manufacturer
manufacturer.remarks: Manufacturer code indicating the company that makes this item.

nextinvoicedate.title: Next Invoice Date
nextinvoicedate.remarks: The next date that an invoice will be generated if one is needed. When the Frequency and Frequency Units fields are specified, the Next Invoice Date will default based on the current date/time plus the frequency.

plusabuy.title: Auto buy
plusabuy.remarks: When selected, this item may be purchased without the consent of the procurement-engineering group  For new inventory records this will be defaulted from the corresponding item master. Changes to item master will not get reflected here though

vendor.title: Primary Vendor
vendor.remarks: Identifier of the primary vendor for the item. Enter the value or click Detail to choose a value. The vendor can be another storeroom if that storeroom supplies the item to the current location. To list a storeroom as the vendor, you must enter it in the Companies table.

consignment.title: Consignment
consignment.remarks: Select this check box to identify the item as a consignment type of item.

minlevel.title: Reorder Point
minlevel.remarks: The minimum quantity of inventory stock items required. When the stock balance reaches this number, the inventory items must be reordered.

curbal.title: Current Balance
curbal.remarks: Quantity of items that exist in the storeroom.

curbaltotal.title: Current Balance
curbaltotal.remarks: The total current balance of an item in the inventory system.

conditioncode.title: ConditionCode
conditioncode.remarks: An Item is in a single or multiple Bins with Conditioncode in a storeroom

invmtol.title: Minus Count Tolerance
invmtol.remarks: Percentage by which a physical count can be below the adjusted balance and still be reconciled. Maximo uses tolerance settings to determine the accuracy of the physical count. An item's tolerance values are storeroom-specific. Maximo uses the tolerance value established in the Organizations application as the default value, unless you enter a value in the Minus Count Tolerance field on the Inventory tab.

lotcnt.title: LOT COUNT
lotcnt.remarks: An Item is in a single or multiple Lots in a storeroom

consvendor.title: Consignment Vendor
consvendor.remarks: The vendor that is responsible for replenishing the consignment items. Purchase orders and invoices are generated for the vendor that is specified in this field.

invgentype.title: Invoice Generation Type
invgentype.remarks: You can specify how the invoice is generated for the current item. You can specify that invoices are generated based on consumption or on frequency or that they are generated manually.

orderunit.title: Order Unit
orderunit.remarks: Unit Of Order. A unit can be each, box, roll, linear feet, cubic feet, square feet etc. For example, 1 box is 1 unit, but the box may be a part of a larger inventory issue element, perhaps a case or crate.

newcosttype.title: New Issue Cost Type
newcosttype.remarks: The issue cost type of an inventory item can be Average, Standard or Asset. You use the Asset cost type for rotating items only.

statusdate.title: Status Date
statusdate.remarks: Date the work order status was last changed.

statusiface.title: Has Status Changed
statusiface.remarks: Non persistent boolean field to indicate whether the status has been changed after the stateful object is fetched from the database.

deliverytime.title: Lead Time (Days)
deliverytime.remarks: The number of days it takes from ordering an item to receiving the item.

catalogcode.title: Catalog #
catalogcode.remarks: Primary vendor's catalog code for this item.

frequnit.title: Frequency Units
frequnit.remarks: The unit of measure for the frequency value.

location.title: Storeroom
location.remarks: The primary location for the selected item. If an item is stored in more than one storeroom location you can select View Availability from the Select Action menu to view balances for all storeroom locations.

np_statusmemo.title: Change Status Memo
np_statusmemo.remarks: Status change memo, temporary non-persistent field used by MEA
